verdicts.why: In Persona the Chameleon's cohorts are only Quentin Beck and Phineas Mason, both caught after Black Cat stops their escape. Beck first appears as Mysterio in Blueprints and is unmasked there, so naming Mysterio at #10 gives away that later reveal.

Everything in stage 0 happens in Reinforcement (#16): Mysterio fights Spider-Man in the mall with homunculi and an exploding robot decoy, then Spider-Man webs and unmasks the real Beck and police take him in. A stage with no episode number sorts before #10, earlier than what it says happens. At #16 the text and card lines hold up, and it follows the #14 'never quite catches' stage.

In Reinforcement the Master Planner is only a shadow and Otto is the Ravencroft patient who refuses to go. He is shown to be the Master Planner at the start of Shear Strength (#17), where he praises the Tinkerer and the Vulture for assembling the tech Mysterio stole. A #16 boss stage with 'Mysterio's leader' gives that reveal away.

Kraven joins the re-formed Six and breaks Electro out of Ravencroft in Reinforcement (#16), and he does not appear in #17. In Shear Strength Otto is shown to be the Master Planner, and Electro asks why he stayed behind when Kraven broke them out. The new text tells that #17 event correctly.

The current text sums up #11, #16 and #17. In Shear Strength, after Electro stuns Gwen, the Vulture carries her off into the skyscrapers while Peter pushes through the crowd and loses sight of them, and he works as Otto's right hand in the lair.

'Peter starts dating Liz' is about Peter and a third person. In Shear Strength Spider-Man pulls Gwen out of Otto's flooding lair, and at midnight Liz kisses Peter while Gwen calls out on the phone line.
The current text is about Harry and Gwen, not Peter and Harry. In First Steps (#18) Peter sees Harry come back from Europe, after learning in #9 that Harry was the Goblin.

No source gives a separate Peter and Gwen scene in Growing Pains. Gwen agreeing to date Harry is her moving on from Peter, which turns their triangle, so it is not just a third person's act nearby. Under the evidence rule it passes.
The sources do not tie Harry's jealousy of Peter to #19. Harry dating the girl Peter loves is the triangle turn between the two friends, and with no sourced error the stage passes.

value.text: Tombstone hires the Tinkerer to build new suits for the Enforcers, and Spider-Man has to face them in the new gear.

verdicts.why: The current text does sum up #16-17 (the Sinister Six) together with #22, and in Probable Cause the Tinkerer only builds the Enforcers' new suits for Tombstone. But no source says the Enforcers 'nearly beat' Spider-Man: the wikis only say he stops them and they are arrested. Separately, Spider-Man catches the Tinkerer and makes him talk in Shear Strength (#17), and that episode has no stage in this pair.

Plotting as the Master Planner from a hidden lair is #14-17. In Gangland Otto fights at the summit and urges the bosses to dispose of Spider-Man, who then disables and coils his arms, and Otto is arrested.

'Enforces for the Big Man and fights Spider-Man again and again' sums up many episodes. In Gangland Hammerhead calls the summit and sets the bosses on each other to become the new Big Man, which starts the gang war that only Spider-Man can stop.

Final Curtain shows Gwen still wearing the look from Mary Jane's makeover, so the text is true for #26. No source names the episode where the makeover happens or first shows, and a stage later than its event breaks no rule.

Card wording is final, and as a through-line Spider-Man keeps clashing with Hammerhead and his schemes: the Enforcers and Shocker (#1-2), the Goblin's trap (#9), the Rhino specs fight (#21) and the gang war (#23). Nothing shows the lines are false.
In Fire Made Flesh the real Jean frees the Goblin Queen with their shared memories, but it is the clone and Cyclops who save Nathan, not Jean and Madelyne together.

The infection and Bishop taking Nathan away happen in #3. In Bright Eyes (#7) Cable arrives, beats the Prime Sentinel Trask, and through Jean everyone learns he is Nathan. He shows little interest in a family reunion.
Stage 1 repeats the #3 infection that stage 0 already tells. In Tolerance Is Extinction Part 2 (#9), at Bastion's Galapagos hideout, Sinister takes over Cable's mind and uses him to overpower Jean.

The X-Men '97 finale cameo shows Peter has found Mary Jane after the 1994 series' last episode, so it comes after Spider-Man (1994)#60 in story order. Placed first, it says they are together before they meet (#3) and gives away that he finds her. A stage is never earlier than what it says has happened, so it belongs last. This is an ordering fix (X-Men '97 sorts after Spider-Man (1994) in this universe); the text stays.

X-Men '97 is set after Spider-Man (1994) ends (the same finale shows Peter has found Mary Jane), so the White House stage comes after the Battleworld team-up at #61 in story order. The text itself is right; only the order changes.

No source shows whether 'Final Horsemen' is or is not said on screen. Marvel Database files this 3960 A.D. group as 'Horsemen of Apocalypse' and only notes it is based on the comics' Final Horsemen, which does not show a factual error. It passes under the evidence rule; checking by watching would settle it.

Marvel Database's own Phalanx Covenant Part II page lists Magneto as a featured member of Beast's group, but Polaris only under 'other characters' with X-Factor, the Phalanx's captives, beside a Quicksilver cameo. No source shows her and Magneto dealing with each other there, and a shared battle is not a stage.
